basics.name: Anh Minh (Eric) Hoang
basics.summary: Research in LLM safety and alignment, focused on detecting attempts to bypass safeguards and understanding how compromised training data changes model behavior.

publications.title: SafePrompt: Jailbreak Search Defense through Activation Signatures
publications.status: ACL ARR, October 2026 cycle · Under review
bullets: Designed a filter that detects attempts to bypass a language model’s safety rules by examining patterns in a separate model’s internal activity.

Across two models, reduced the success of an automated attack from 91–92% to 14–17% after 90 attempts per goal; blocked 2.53% of 750 legitimate requests. Evaluated repeated attacks, attacker feedback, and the cost of rejecting valid requests.

publications.title: Latent-Target Poisoning: Discovering Attack Populations in Coding Assistants
publications.status: ACL ARR, October 2026 cycle · Under review
bullets: Investigated how tampered training examples can teach coding assistants to insert unwanted code into answers to ordinary requests, without adding a trigger to the user’s prompt.

Built controlled experiments across two model families and two coding datasets, comparing four ways of selecting affected requests. Measured unwanted-code generation, effects on other requests, and performance on standard coding tasks.

publications.title: CSR: Physically conditioned scale-transfer super-resolution across optical missions
publications.authors: Minh A. Hoang and Nidal Kamel
publications.status: Under review at ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
bullets: Developed a model that improves the spatial detail of satellite images from different sensors, using wavelength and pixel-size information instead of a separate model for each sensor.
Achieved the largest mean structural improvement among compared methods on all four 4× OpenSR benchmark suites. Tested adaptation to new satellite data, including 174 held-out PROBA-V scenes.
Built satellite-image training and evaluation pipelines in PyTorch Lightning and Hydra for Sentinel-2, Landsat 8/9, NAIP, and VENµS, using data accessed through Planetary Computer STAC.

awards.text: Regional winner, RMIT AI Hackathon; highest AU-ROC model among 400+ teams.
Top 13 among 100+ university teams, 1st Vietnamese National Collegiate AI Olympiad (OLPAI).

skills.Research: Language-model safety evaluation, model representations, training-data security, controlled experiments.
skills.Tools: Python, PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, Hydra, Hugging Face Transformers, LoRA/PEFT.
